hero.blurb: 5+ years building production web applications across LTIMindtree and BrowserStack. I work across React and TypeScript with a focus on frontend architecture, performance, observability and developer workflows.

about.p1: Five years building production software across LTIMindtree and BrowserStack. I've worked across frontend, backend and developer tooling - from React and Angular interfaces to Java microservices, browser extensions, testing infrastructure and observability.
about.p2: I'm happiest when a messy problem becomes a simple interface, a slow workflow gets faster, or a production issue becomes a metric we can actually understand.

projects.name: KanBan Board
projects.blurb: Kanban is a comprehensive web application to facilitate agile software delivery methodologies. It incorporates features like user authentication, project creation, task addition, task specific comments and collaboration.
projects.snippet:
POST /projects
→ create project
→ add tasks
→ comment
→ collaborate
projects.hard: The challenging part was keeping task updates, comments, and collaboration consistent across users while making the workflow feel simple and responsive.

projects.name: Coptime
projects.blurb: The project was to automate and digitalize the complaint filing process in a police station as well as an emergency SOS to notify the nearest police stations. It was built using react native and web dashboard
projects.snippet:
SOS → locate nearest station
complaint → submit → track
station → dashboard → respond
projects.hard: The difficult part was connecting a mobile-first complaint and SOS workflow with a web dashboard while keeping emergency information clear and actionable for police personnel.

projects.name: Motherboard
projects.blurb: Created a student-teacher portal for enhancing the learning process with a WhatsApp type interface for sharing important information, attendance manager and a grievances portal. It is a real time chat application.
projects.snippet:
message → realtime sync
attendance → mark → review
grievance → submit → resolve
projects.hard: The challenge was bringing chat, attendance, announcements, and grievances into one interface without making the portal feel like a collection of disconnected tools.

projects.name: Water.io
projects.blurb: An interactive webapp to predict groundwater level for the user specified region, for upcoming 10 years with an accuracy of 90%,(ARIMA Model). The data was scraped from data.gov.in using Flask.
projects.snippet:
data.gov.in → scrape → clean
→ ARIMA → forecast → visualize
projects.hard: The hardest part was turning inconsistent groundwater datasets into a reliable time series that could be fed into an ARIMA model and presented as an understandable regional forecast.

notes.body: If an animation cannot be cancelled mid-flight, it is a cutscene, and nobody asked for a cutscene.
Every effect ships with a frame budget. Nice is not a metric. Neither is smooth.
Show me your empty states and I can tell you how the rest of the product was built.

stops.detail: Was amongst the early developers and worked on the initial website and core product features.
Built Android and iOS applications for Big Boy Toyz, a luxury car resale brand, and developed the company's portfolio website, which was featured for Engineering & Design on Awwwards.

Worked on Canvas, an AI/ML-powered platform, building production features across React, Angular, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Designed and developed 15+ UI screens, built a Chrome extension and Java agent to streamline regression testing across 2,000+ test cases, reducing testing time by 40%.

Building Test Management for Jira, a Jira-native test management platform within BrowserStack. Driving frontend development with React and TypeScript while contributing to application architecture, performance optimization, observability and CI/CD workflows. Focused on building scalable product experiences and improving how application performance and production issues are measured, diagnosed and resolved.
